subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's default-off Feishu `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` top-level/per-account config as the product contract for proactive per-target outbound pacing?
rationale: Source review shows the missing capability and the PR is a plausible Feishu-local implementation, but config naming/default semantics and the acceptable live-proof bar are maintainer product/API choices.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
options.body: Proceed with this PR or a rebased replacement after real Feishu proof confirms same-target pacing and distinct-target independence.

options.title: Keep Only Reactive Retry
options.body: Reject the new config surface and document that OpenClaw relies on existing Feishu retry/backoff after rate-limit responses.

options.title: Defer To Broad Rate Limiting
options.body: Leave Feishu-specific pacing out of the plugin and make the broader cross-provider rate-limit issue own this policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR or a rebased replacement after real Feishu proof confirms same-target pacing and distinct-target independence.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin owner candidate for Feishu-owned send behavior.
